literal: The emperor said: "Archery is to view virtue—therefore it was so named.
idiomatic: The emperor said, "Archery is to view virtue—therefore the name.

literal: Next they reached the Serene-Leisure Hall.
idiomatic: Next they reached the Serene-Leisure Hall.

literal: The emperor said: "This hall takes the Master's at-ease meaning.
idiomatic: The emperor said, "This hall takes the Master's at-ease meaning.

literal: One must not indulge luxury and forget frugality, settle in ease and forget peril—therefore behind this hall the Thatched Hall was built.
idiomatic: One must not indulge luxury and forget frugality, settle in ease and forget peril—therefore behind it stands the Thatched Hall.

literal: He told Li Chong: "East of here is the Pace-Origin Gallery; west is the Roaming-Triumph Gallery.
idiomatic: He told Li Chong, "East is the Pace-Origin Gallery; west is the Roaming-Triumph Gallery.

literal: Though we lack a ruler like Tang Yao, you should not be shamed before Yuan and Kai.
idiomatic: Though we lack a ruler like Tang Yao, you should not be shamed before Yuan and Kai.

literal: Chong replied: "Your servant has met a ruler like Tang Yao—how dare I decline Yuan and Kai's praise?
idiomatic: Chong replied, "Your servant has met a ruler like Tang Yao—how dare I decline Yuan and Kai's praise?

literal: The emperor said: "Light is falling; I share with the clan the meaning of keeping vigil for elders—you are about to leave; how can you be silent in virtue's voice.
idiomatic: The emperor said, "Light is falling; I share with the clan vigil for elders—you are about to leave; how can you be silent?

literal: He at once ordered Palace Attendant Cui Guang, Guo Zuo, Unimpeded Attendant Xing Luan, Cui Xiu, and others to compose poems declaring their hearts.
idiomatic: He ordered Palace Attendant Cui Guang, Guo Zuo, Unimpeded Attendant Xing Luan, Cui Xiu, and others to compose poems.

literal: When candles came, dukes and ministers withdrew; Li Chong bowed again and offered long life.
idiomatic: When candles came, dukes and ministers withdrew; Li Chong bowed again and offered long life.

literal: The emperor said: "You take candle's coming as leave and again offer long life; I repay you with the ode Southern Mountains.
idiomatic: The emperor said, "You take the candle as leave and again offer long life; I repay you with Southern Mountains.

literal: He then said: "Candle comes and guests withdraw—that is commoners' rite;
idiomatic: He said, "Candle comes and guests withdraw—that is commoners' rite;

literal: to keep vigil at night is the clan's meaning.
idiomatic: to keep vigil at night is the clan's meaning.

literal: You may return; I with the kings and clan wish to finish this night's drinking.
idiomatic: Return; I with the kings and clan will finish this night's drinking.

literal: Later he was removed from office for public affairs.
idiomatic: Later he was removed from office over public affairs.

literal: Soon he held the Ministry of Personnel concurrently again.
idiomatic: Soon he held the Ministry of Personnel again.

literal: Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai plotted rebellion in the province; Cheng was given the tally, bronze martial and bamboo civil tallies, imperial guards at the side, and still conducted Hengzhou affairs.
idiomatic: Mu Tai, inspector of Hengzhou, plotted rebellion; Cheng was given tallies, imperial guards, and still ran Hengzhou.

literal: Reaching Yanmen he sent Palace Attendant Li Huan ahead.
idiomatic: Reaching Yanmen he sent Palace Attendant Li Huan ahead.

literal: On arrival he seized Tai at once and exhausted his faction; all culprits were taken.
idiomatic: On arrival he seized Tai and exhausted his faction; all culprits were taken.

literal: Duke of Julu Lu Rui, Marquis of Anle Yuan Long, and more than a hundred others were all imprisoned.
idiomatic: Duke of Julu Lu Rui, Marquis of Anle Yuan Long, and more than a hundred others were imprisoned.

literal: The full report was memorialized.
idiomatic: The full report was memorialized.

literal: The emperor read the memorial and was greatly pleased: "My Prince of Rencheng may be called a pillar of the state; even Gao Yao judging cases could not surpass this!
idiomatic: The emperor read it and was greatly pleased. "My Prince of Rencheng is a pillar of the state; even Gao Yao judging cases could not surpass this!

literal: He turned to Prince of Xianyang and the rest: "If you were in his place you could not have managed this.
idiomatic: He turned to Prince of Xianyang and the rest. "In his place you could not have managed this.

literal: The carriage soon visited Pingcheng.
idiomatic: The carriage soon visited Pingcheng.

literal: Cheng was rewarded with audience; the rebels were led before him and not one claimed injustice.
idiomatic: Cheng was rewarded with audience; rebels were led before him and not one claimed injustice.

literal: At the time none did not sigh in admiration.
idiomatic: At the time none did not sigh in admiration.

literal: The emperor told those at his side: "Confucius said there would be no lawsuits—today I have seen it.
idiomatic: The emperor told those at his side, "Confucius said there would be no lawsuits—today I have seen it.

literal: Cheng was made regular director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: Cheng was made regular director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the southern campaign the carriage left Cheng to guard the capital, again with right vice directorship concurrently.
idiomatic: On the southern campaign the carriage left Cheng to guard the capital, again with right vice directorship.

literal: Cheng memorialized asking to give one year's rent in silk of the state fief for army supplies; an edict accepted half.
idiomatic: Cheng asked to give one year's state-fief rent in silk for the army; an edict took half.

literal: The emperor again visited Ye.
idiomatic: The emperor again visited Ye.

literal: Seeing dukes and ministers he said: "Yesterday entering the city I saw women in carts wearing caps and small jackets—why did the Masters of Writing not investigate?
idiomatic: Seeing ministers he said, "Yesterday entering the city I saw women in carts wearing caps and small jackets—why did the Masters of Writing not investigate?

literal: Cheng said: "Those who wear them are still few.
idiomatic: Cheng said, "Those who wear them are still few.

literal: The emperor said: "Does Prince of Rencheng wish all to wear them?
idiomatic: The emperor said, "Does Prince of Rencheng wish all to wear them?

literal: One word can lose a state—this is what is meant.
idiomatic: One word can lose a state—this is what is meant.

literal: Order the historiographers to record it.
idiomatic: Order the historiographers to record it.

literal: He also said: "A king does not lower himself to the blue heavens but raises talent and employs it.
idiomatic: He also said, "A king does not lower himself to the blue heavens but raises talent and employs it.

literal: I failed in choosing men and put a crowd of women in charge—I must grade again.
idiomatic: I failed in choosing men and put women in charge—I must grade again.

literal: Prince of Rencheng is in the capital as the realm's great warp—does he only sign documents?
idiomatic: Prince of Rencheng is in the capital as the realm's warp—does he only sign documents?

literal: Cheng said: "Your servant truly only signs documents.
idiomatic: Cheng said, "Your servant truly only signs documents.

literal: The emperor said: "If so, one clerk suffices—why wait for Prince of Rencheng?
idiomatic: The emperor said, "If so, one clerk suffices—why wait for Prince of Rencheng?

literal: Soon he was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and followed the carriage on the southern campaign.
idiomatic: Soon he was made left vice director and followed the southern campaign.

literal: When Xiaowen died he received the final charge.
idiomatic: When Xiaowen died he received the final charge.

literal: At the start of Emperor Xuanwu, a surrendered man Yan Shumao reported Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Su had sent Kong Sida in secret contact with Qi as rebellion.
idiomatic: At the start of Xuanwu, a surrendered man Yan Shumao reported Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Su sent Kong Sida in secret contact with Qi as rebellion.

literal: Cheng believed it and memorialized that Su was about to rebel, and at once forbade and detained him.
idiomatic: Cheng believed it and memorialized that Su would rebel, and at once detained him.

literal: Princes of Xianyang and Beihai memorialized that Cheng had detained a chief minister on his own authority; he was removed and returned to his residence.
idiomatic: Princes of Xianyang and Beihai memorialized that Cheng detained a chief minister on his own; he was removed to his residence.

literal: Soon he was made commander with an open office and Inspector of Yangzhou.
idiomatic: Soon he was made commander with an open office and inspector of Yangzhou.

literal: On taking his post he sealed Sun Shuao's tomb and destroyed Jiang Ziwen's shrine;
idiomatic: On taking his post he sealed Sun Shuao's tomb and destroyed Jiang Ziwen's shrine;

literal: he memorialized asking to restore the Imperial Clan School and open the Four Gates teaching.
idiomatic: he memorialized to restore the Imperial Clan School and open the Four Gates teaching.

literal: An edict followed it.
idiomatic: An edict followed.

literal: Earlier court discussion had a plan for southern campaign; Xiao Baoyin was made Inspector of Eastern Yangzhou, holding the eastern city;
idiomatic: Earlier the court planned southern campaign; Xiao Baoyin was made inspector of Eastern Yangzhou, holding the eastern city;

literal: Chen Bozhi was made Inspector of Jiangzhou, garrisoning Yangshi.
idiomatic: Chen Bozhi was made inspector of Jiangzhou, garrisoning Yangshi.

literal: Cheng was made overall commander of the two garrisons and given their regulation.
idiomatic: Cheng was made overall commander of the two garrisons with full regulation.

literal: Cheng then sent Commander Fu Shuyan, Wang Shennian, and others to advance to Da Xian, Dongguan, Jiushan, and Huailing, each with generals in division, doubling pace to seize them.
idiomatic: Cheng sent Commander Fu Shuyan, Wang Shennian, and others to Da Xian, Dongguan, Jiushan, and Huailing, generals in division at double pace.

literal: Cheng overall led the great host in continuous array; wherever he went he conquered; edicts praised him.
idiomatic: Cheng led the great host in continuous array; wherever he went he conquered; edicts praised him.

literal: Then rain came and the Huai rose in flood; Cheng withdrew to Shouchun.
idiomatic: Then rain came and the Huai flooded; Cheng withdrew to Shouchun.

literal: The return was disordered; more than four thousand soldiers were lost.
idiomatic: The return was disordered; more than four thousand soldiers were lost.

literal: Cheng repeatedly memorialized asking to resign the province; the emperor did not permit.
idiomatic: Cheng repeatedly asked to resign the province; the emperor refused.

literal: The relevant office memorialized to strip his open office; he was also demoted three ranks.
idiomatic: The relevant office memorialized to strip his open office; he was demoted three ranks.

literal: Transferred to Grand General Who Guards the North and Inspector of Dingzhou.
idiomatic: Transferred to Grand General Who Guards the North and inspector of Dingzhou.

literal: At first the people had many forced levies and constantly suffered.
idiomatic: At first the people had many forced levies and constantly suffered.

literal: Former inspectors and governors could not remove them; Cheng removed many.
idiomatic: Former inspectors could not remove them; Cheng removed many.

literal: He also clarified the law of promotion, demotion, reward, and punishment, memorialized to reduce parklands for landless poor, and forbade making cloth and silk unfit for clothing—the people rejoiced and relied on him.
idiomatic: He clarified promotion and punishment, reduced parklands for the landless poor, and forbade cloth unfit for clothing—the people rejoiced.

literal: When Grand Consort Meng died his mourning exceeded measure; the age praised him.
idiomatic: When Grand Consort Meng died his mourning exceeded measure; the age praised him.

literal: When mourning ended he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir.
idiomatic: When mourning ended he was made junior tutor of the heir.

literal: At the time Gao Zhao held court and was jealous of worthy kin.
idiomatic: Gao Zhao then held court and was jealous of worthy kin.

literal: Cheng was slandered by Zhao's intrigues and constantly feared he would not survive, so all day he drank in stupor to show ruin.
idiomatic: Cheng was slandered by Zhao and constantly feared for his life, so he drank all day to show ruin.

literal: What he did was bizarre and excessive; the age called him mad.
idiomatic: What he did was bizarre; the age called him mad.

literal: When Xuanwu died suddenly affairs were rushed; Gao Zhao held troops outside.
idiomatic: When Xuanwu died suddenly affairs were rushed; Gao Zhao held troops outside.

literal: Emperor Ming was young; court and countryside were unsettled.
idiomatic: Emperor Ming was young; court and countryside were unsettled.

literal: Though Cheng was kept at a distance, court hope rested on him.
idiomatic: Though kept at a distance, court hope rested on Cheng.

literal: Commander of the Guards Yu Zhong, Palace Attendant Cui Guang, and others memorialized Cheng as Director of the Masters of Writing; the crowd's hearts were then pleased.
idiomatic: Commander of the Guards Yu Zhong, Palace Attendant Cui Guang, and others memorialized Cheng as director; hearts were pleased.

literal: Soon he was transferred to Minister of Works with palace attendance; soon an edict had him lead the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: Soon he was minister of works with palace attendance; soon an edict had him lead the Masters of Writing.

literal: He submitted to the throne Imperial Instructions on Clan Regulation and Glosses, one scroll each, wishing the empress dowager to read them and think on admonition's benefit.
idiomatic: He submitted Imperial Instructions on Clan Regulation and Glosses, one scroll each, for the empress dowager's admonition.

literal: He also memorialized ten items fitting the state and benefiting the people: first, laws, measures, and scales differ between public and private and should be unified;
idiomatic: He memorialized ten items for state and people: first, laws, measures, and scales differ public and private and should be one;

literal: second, schools should be raised to clarify promotion and demotion;
idiomatic: second, raise schools to clarify promotion and demotion;

literal: third, extinct lines should be continued, each recommending what he knows;
idiomatic: third, continue extinct lines, each recommending what he knows;

literal: fourth, beyond the five levies, nothing should trouble the people; use of men's strength should not exceed three days;
idiomatic: fourth, beyond the five levies nothing should trouble the people; labor should not exceed three days;

literal: fifth, officials over the people must be promoted or demoted to mark reward and punishment;
idiomatic: fifth, officials must be promoted or demoted to mark reward and punishment;

literal: sixth, for fugitives who pay substitute tax, if away many years and not artisans, let them stay where they are;
idiomatic: sixth, fugitives paying substitute tax, if away years and not artisans, let them stay;

literal: seventh, frontier soldiers who flee, or truly fall in battle, must be closely checked; if the three chiefs and near kin truly hide them, collect substitute tax—if not hidden, do not punish;
idiomatic: seventh, fleeing frontier soldiers or those truly lost must be checked; if three chiefs and kin hide them, collect substitute tax—if not hidden, do not punish;

literal: eighth, artisan and merchant hereditary households again pay rent and levy and cannot bear it—now ask exemption so they may keep their trades;
idiomatic: eighth, artisan and merchant households again pay rent and cannot bear it—ask exemption so they keep their trades;

literal: ninth, the three chiefs forbid crime and must not oversee across lines; households not full should be merged with the nearest;
idiomatic: ninth, three chiefs forbid crime and must not oversee across lines; short households merge with the nearest;

literal: tenth, armored guards and martial cadets—when the frontier has affairs they may go to battle for a time; regular garrison should send rotating troops in replacement.
idiomatic: tenth, armored guards—when the frontier has affairs they may fight for a time; regular garrison should send rotating troops.

literal: Empress Dowager Ling sent down his memorial; the hundred offices deliberated; matters had agreement and disagreement.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling sent down his memorial; offices deliberated; some agreed, some not.

literal: At the time the four central commanders' troops were few and weak, insufficient to gird the capital.
idiomatic: The four central commanders' troops were few, insufficient to gird the capital.

literal: Cheng memorialized that the eastern center should hold Yingyang commandery, the southern Luoyang, the western Hengnong, the northern Henei, choosing second- and third-rank kin both noble and worthy to dwell there.
idiomatic: Cheng memorialized the eastern center hold Yingyang, southern Luoyang, western Hengnong, northern Henei, with worthy kin of second and third rank.

literal: Non-urgent work should be cut and strong troops attached.
idiomatic: Cut non-urgent work and attach strong troops.

literal: Thus deep roots and solid trunk, strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches.
idiomatic: Thus deep roots and solid trunk—strengthen the trunk, weaken the branches.

literal: Empress Dowager Ling was about to follow it; followers of other views differed, and it stopped.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling was about to follow; other views differed, and it stopped.

literal: Soon, because of illness, he memorialized asking to resign; it was not permitted.
idiomatic: Soon illness made him ask to resign; it was refused.

literal: Cheng because northern frontier commanders' selection grew ever lighter, fearing barbarians would spy the border and the imperial tombs be endangered, memorialized asking to weight frontier commanders' choice and tighten guard and warning—an edict did not follow.
idiomatic: Cheng feared frontier selection grew light, barbarians would spy the border and tombs be endangered, and asked to weight commanders and tighten guard—the edict did not follow.

literal: Later barbarians invaded to the old capital; commanders were mostly not the right men;
idiomatic: Later barbarians invaded to the old capital; commanders were mostly wrong men;

literal: rebellion rose everywhere, pressing the tombs, as Cheng had feared.
idiomatic: rebellion rose everywhere, pressing the tombs, as Cheng had feared.

literal: Cheng memorialized: "Capital offices and temples are not yet complete; the army is newly quiet and the people should not be mobilized—take from functionaries and from Si Province and commanderies criminals from ten blows to a hundred lashes who may redeem with goods: one bolt of silk equals two hundred bricks, to repair step by step.
idiomatic: Cheng memorialized, "Capital offices are not complete; the army is newly quiet—do not mobilize the people; take from functionaries and Si Province criminals from ten blows to a hundred lashes who redeem: one bolt of silk equals two hundred bricks, to repair step by step.

literal: An edict followed it.
idiomatic: An edict followed.

literal: Grand Tutor Prince of Qinghe Yi memorialized to reject the matter; it then slept and was not carried out.
idiomatic: Grand Tutor Prince of Qinghe Yi memorialized to reject it; it slept and was not carried out.

literal: Cheng again memorialized: "Inspector of Si Province, Prince of Gaoyang Yong, beat to death Court Attendant Han Yuanzhao and former Gate Office recorder Yao Jingxian—though on public business, reason was not exhausted.
idiomatic: Cheng again memorialized, "Inspector of Si Province Prince of Gaoyang Yong beat Court Attendant Han Yuanzhao and former Gate recorder Yao Jingxian to death—though public business, reason was not exhausted.

literal: How so?
idiomatic: How so?

literal: If Zhao and the rest's guilt was manifest, death was fixed and they should be executed in the market and abandoned with the crowd.
idiomatic: If Zhao and the rest's guilt was manifest, death was fixed—they should be executed in the market and abandoned with the crowd.
